```{r data}
curve_files <- list(
  usa = "usa-bs.csv",
  gbr = "gbr-bs.csv",
  jpn = "jpn-bs.csv",
  cad = "cad-bs.csv",
  ger = "ger-bs.csv", 
  fra = "fra-bs.csv"
)

curves <- names(curve_files)
mats <- c(1, 3, 6, 12, 24, 60, 84, 120, 240, 360)

start_date <- as.Date("2010-01-01")
end_date <- as.Date("2020-12-31")
lambdas <- seq(0.01, 0.15, by = 0.005)
cutoffs <- c(4, 8)

yields <- lapply(curve_files, function(file_name) {
  read.csv(here::here("reconstructed_data", file_name), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
})

yields <- lapply(yields, function(curve_df) {
  curve_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      as.Date(time) >= start_date,
      as.Date(time) <= end_date
    )
})

## truncated yields: window only 
years <- 2010:2020

annual_yields <- setNames(lapply(years, function(year) {
  lapply(yields, function(curve_df) {
    curve_df %>%
      dplyr::filter(format(as.Date(time), "%Y") == as.character(year))
  })
}), years)
```

```{r helpers}
build_curve_panel <- function(yield_list, curves) {
  out <- data.frame(time = as.Date(yield_list[[1]]$time))

  for (curve_name in curves) {
    curve_df <- yield_list[[curve_name]][, -1, drop = FALSE]
    colnames(curve_df) <- paste0(curve_name, ".", sub("^X", "", colnames(curve_df)))
    out <- cbind(out, curve_df)
  }

  return(out)
}

fit_annual_dly_models <- function(annual_yields, mats, lambdas, curves, reference,
                                  seed = NULL, center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE) {
  if (!is.null(seed)) {
    set.seed(seed)
  }

  setNames(lapply(annual_yields, function(yield_window) {
    dly_fit(
      yields = yield_window,
      mats = mats,
      lambdas = lambdas,
      curves = curves,
      reference = reference,
      center = center,
      scale. = scale.
    )
  }), names(annual_yields))
}

fit_annual_baseline_models <- function(annual_yields, mats, lambdas, curves, seed = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(seed)) {
    set.seed(seed)
  }

  setNames(lapply(annual_yields, function(yield_window) {
    dly_all_sc(
      lambdas = lambdas,
      yields = yield_window,
      mats = mats,
      curves = curves
    )
  }), names(annual_yields))
}

extract_annual_baseline_estimates <- function(annual_baseline_fits, curves) {
  setNames(lapply(annual_baseline_fits, function(fit_obj) {
    setNames(lapply(curves, function(curve_name) {
      baseline_fit <- fit_obj[[curve_name]]
      baseline_df <- data.frame(baseline_fit$time, as.data.frame(baseline_fit$nsfit$NSfit))
      colnames(baseline_df) <- c("time", baseline_fit$yield_names)
      baseline_df
    }), curves)
  }), names(annual_baseline_fits))
}

extract_annual_dly_estimates <- function(annual_dly_fits, curves,
                                         component = c("raw", "global", "idiosyncratic")) {
  component <- match.arg(component)

  setNames(lapply(annual_dly_fits, function(fit_obj) {
    fit_obj$yields[[component]][curves]
  }), names(annual_dly_fits))
}

build_error_matrix <- function(actual_panel, fitted_panel) {
  actual_panel <- actual_panel %>%
    dplyr::mutate(time = as.Date(time)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(time)

  fitted_panel <- fitted_panel %>%
    dplyr::mutate(time = as.Date(time)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(time)

  common_time <- intersect(actual_panel$time, fitted_panel$time)

  actual_panel <- actual_panel[match(common_time, actual_panel$time), , drop = FALSE]
  fitted_panel <- fitted_panel[match(common_time, fitted_panel$time), , drop = FALSE]

  common_cols <- setdiff(intersect(colnames(actual_panel), colnames(fitted_panel)), "time")
  error_mat <- as.matrix(actual_panel[, common_cols, drop = FALSE] -
    fitted_panel[, common_cols, drop = FALSE])
  colnames(error_mat) <- common_cols
  error_mat
}

bind_annual_errors <- function(actual_annual_panels, fitted_annual_panels) {
  purrr::imap_dfr(actual_annual_panels, function(actual_panel, year_label) {
    error_mat <- build_error_matrix(actual_panel, fitted_annual_panels[[year_label]])
    tibble::as_tibble(error_mat) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        year = as.integer(year_label),
        .before = 1
      )
  })
}

error_summary <- function(error_df, model_name) {
  error_mat <- as.matrix(error_df[, setdiff(colnames(error_df), "year"), drop = FALSE])

  error_long <- tibble::as_tibble(error_mat) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = dplyr::everything(),
      names_to = "series",
      values_to = "error"
    ) %>%
    tidyr::separate(series, into = c("curve", "maturity"), sep = "\\.", remove = FALSE)

  list(
    overall = tibble::tibble(
      model = model_name,
      rmse = sqrt(mean(error_mat^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
      mae = mean(abs(error_mat), na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    by_curve = error_long %>%
      dplyr::group_by(curve) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        model = model_name,
        rmse = sqrt(mean(error^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
        mae = mean(abs(error), na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by_maturity = error_long %>%
      dplyr::group_by(maturity) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        model = model_name,
        rmse = sqrt(mean(error^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
        mae = mean(abs(error), na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by_curve_tenor = error_long %>%
      dplyr::group_by(curve, tenor = maturity) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        model = model_name,
        rmse = sqrt(mean(error^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
        mae = mean(abs(error), na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  )
}

mc_fit_spec_ready <- function(fit_spec) {
  if (is.null(fit_spec$xt_smooth)) {
    return(FALSE)
  }

  if (isTRUE(fit_spec$xt_smooth) && is.null(fit_spec$smoother)) {
    return(FALSE)
  }

  if (is.null(fit_spec$cov_shrink_diag)) {
    return(FALSE)
  }

  TRUE
}

fit_annual_mc_models <- function(annual_yields, mats, lambdas, cutoffs, curves, reference,
                                 fit_spec, seed = NULL) {
  if (!mc_fit_spec_ready(fit_spec)) {
    stop("fit_spec must include xt_smooth, smoother (if xt_smooth = TRUE), and cov_shrink_diag before running mc_fit_end().")
  }

  if (!is.null(seed)) {
    set.seed(seed)
  }

  setNames(lapply(annual_yields, function(yield_window) {
    mc_fit_end(
      yields = yield_window,
      lambdas = lambdas,
      cutoffs = cutoffs,
      reference = reference,
      curves = curves,
      mats = mats,
      X_trunc = fit_spec$x_trunc,
      Xt_smooth = fit_spec$xt_smooth,
      smoother = fit_spec$smoother,
      CR_S0_shrink_diag = fit_spec$cov_shrink_diag
    )
  }), names(annual_yields))
}

extract_annual_mc_estimates <- function(annual_mc_fits, component = c("curve", "tenor")) {
  component <- match.arg(component)

  setNames(lapply(annual_mc_fits, function(fit_obj) {
    fit_obj[[component]] %>%
      dplyr::mutate(time = as.Date(time)) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(time)
  }), names(annual_mc_fits))
}

bind_metric_component <- function(metric_list, component) {
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(metric_list, `[[`, component))
}

compute_curve_metrics <- function(actual_annual_panels, fitted_annual_panels, model_name) {
  error_summary(
    bind_annual_errors(actual_annual_panels, fitted_annual_panels),
    model_name = model_name
  )$by_curve_tenor
}

score_mc_shrink_grid <- function(shrink_grid, annual_yields, annual_actual_panels, mats, lambdas,
                                 cutoffs, curves, reference, base_spec, seed = NULL) {
  purrr::map_dfr(shrink_grid, function(shrink_value) {
    fit_spec <- utils::modifyList(base_spec, list(cov_shrink_diag = shrink_value))

    mc_fits <- fit_annual_mc_models(
      annual_yields = annual_yields,
      mats = mats,
      lambdas = lambdas,
      cutoffs = cutoffs,
      curves = curves,
      reference = reference,
      fit_spec = fit_spec,
      seed = seed
    )

    mc_curve_estimates <- extract_annual_mc_estimates(mc_fits, component = "curve")
    mc_errors <- bind_annual_errors(annual_actual_panels, mc_curve_estimates)
    mc_metrics <- error_summary(mc_errors, "mc_end")

    tibble::tibble(
      cov_shrink_diag = shrink_value,
      rmse = mc_metrics$overall$rmse,
      mae = mc_metrics$overall$mae
    )
  }) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(rmse, mae, cov_shrink_diag)
}
```

```{r fit-mc-end-curves}
mc_shrink_search_spec <- list(
  x_trunc = TRUE,
  xt_smooth = FALSE,
  smoother = NULL,
  cov_shrink_diag = NULL
)

mc_cov_shrink_grid <- seq(0, 1, by = 0.1)

mc_shrink_grid_results <- score_mc_shrink_grid(
  shrink_grid = mc_cov_shrink_grid,
  annual_yields = annual_yields,
  annual_actual_panels = annual_actual_panels,
  mats = mats,
  lambdas = lambdas,
  cutoffs = cutoffs,
  curves = curves,
  reference = dly_reference,
  base_spec = mc_shrink_search_spec,
  seed = fit_seed
)

mc_optimal_cov_shrink_diag <- mc_shrink_grid_results$cov_shrink_diag[[1]]

mc_run_spec <- utils::modifyList(
  mc_shrink_search_spec,
  list(cov_shrink_diag = mc_optimal_cov_shrink_diag)
)

mc_annual_fits <- fit_annual_mc_models(
  annual_yields = annual_yields,
  mats = mats,
  lambdas = lambdas,
  cutoffs = cutoffs,
  curves = curves,
  reference = dly_reference,
  fit_spec = mc_run_spec,
  seed = fit_seed
)

annual_mc_curve_estimates <- extract_annual_mc_estimates(mc_annual_fits, component = "curve")
```

```{r curve-metrics}
  fitted_annual_panels = lapply(annual_baseline_estimates, build_curve_panel, curves = curves),

  model_name = "dly"

mc_end_curve_metrics <- compute_curve_metrics(
  actual_annual_panels = annual_actual_panels,
  fitted_annual_panels = annual_mc_curve_estimates,
  model_name = "mc_end"
)

curve_metrics <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  baseline_curve_metrics,
  dly_curve_metrics,
  mc_end_curve_metrics
)

curve_metric_table <- curve_metrics %>%
  dplyr::select(model, curve, tenor, rmse, mae) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = model,
    values_from = c(rmse, mae),
    names_glue = "{model}_{.value}"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(curve, match(tenor, as.character(mats)))
```
